exercises.title: U4 听力·对话 Booking a Train Ticket
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Clerk: Good morning. Where would you like to travel to?
Daiyu: We'd like two tickets from Vancouver to Toronto, please.
Clerk: That's a long trip. The whole journey takes about four days.
Daiyu: Four days? We didn't expect it to be so long.
Clerk: Yes, the train crosses the mountains and the great prairie on the way.
Daiyu: That sounds wonderful. Do the seats turn into beds at night?
Clerk: They do. You can sleep while the train keeps moving.
Daiyu: Perfect. We'll take the two tickets, then. Thank you!
exercises.translation_cn: 戴玉想订两张从温哥华到多伦多的火车票;职员说全程约四天,会翻越山脉、穿过大草原;戴玉没料到这么久;座位夜里能变成床,可以边睡边赶路;戴玉决定就买这两张票。

questions.stem: Where do the girls want to travel?
How long does the whole journey take?
What does the train cross on the way?
options: The mountains and the great prairie.

questions.stem: What happens to the seats at night?
What does Daiyu decide in the end?

exercises.title: U4 听力·短文 One of the World's Longest Railways
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: The railway across Canada is one of the longest in the world.
It links the west coast with the cities of the far east.
More than a hundred years ago, the line did not exist.
Builders had to cut a path through forests, plains, and high mountains.
Today travellers can watch the spectacular land roll past their windows.
exercises.translation_cn: 横贯加拿大的铁路是世界上最长的铁路之一;它把西海岸和遥远东部的城市连在一起;一百多年前这条线还不存在;建设者必须在森林、平原和高山中开出一条路;如今旅客可以看着壮丽的大地从车窗外掠过。

questions.stem: What is special about this railway?
options: It is the shortest in Canada.
It is one of the world's longest.

questions.stem: What does the railway link together?
options: The west coast and the far-eastern cities.

questions.stem: When did the line not yet exist?
options: More than a hundred years ago.

questions.stem: What did the builders have to cut a path through?
What can travellers do today?
options: Watch the spectacular land roll past.

exercises.title: U4 听力·对话 Skating on a Frozen Lake
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Liu Qian: That lake looks so blue. Is it always like that?
Anna: In summer, yes. But in winter it freezes over completely.
Liu Qian: Really? Doesn't it become dangerous then?
Anna: Not at all. The ice grows very thick, so people skate on it.
Liu Qian: That sounds amazing. What else do they do there?
Anna: They play games on the ice and even drink hot coffee by the shore.
Liu Qian: I wish we could see it in winter.
Anna: You really should come back. The frozen lake takes your breath away.
exercises.translation_cn: 刘倩问那湖是否一直这么蓝;安娜说夏天是,冬天会完全结冰;刘倩担心危险;安娜说冰很厚,人们在上面滑冰、玩游戏,还在岸边喝热咖啡;刘倩希望冬天能来看;安娜说一定要再来,结冰的湖美得令人惊叹。

questions.stem: What is the lake like in winter?
Why is the frozen lake not dangerous?
options: Because the ice grows very thick.
Because no one goes near it.

questions.stem: What do people do on the ice besides skating?
options: They play games and drink hot coffee.

questions.stem: What does Liu Qian wish?
options: That she could see the lake in winter.

questions.stem: What does Anna say about the frozen lake?
options: It is too cold to visit.
It looks the same all year.

exercises.title: U4 听力·短文 A Small Town on the Prairie
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Our train stopped for a short while at a small prairie town.
The land all around was as flat as the eye could see.
Golden wheat fields stretched far into the distance.
An old farmer told us that the winters here are freezing cold.
Yet in summer, he said, the days are long and pleasant.
exercises.translation_cn: 火车在一个草原小镇短暂停留;四周的土地一望无际地平坦;金色的麦田延伸到远方;一位老农告诉我们这里冬天极冷;但他说夏天白昼漫长而宜人。

questions.stem: Where did the train stop for a short while?
What was the land around like?
options: As flat as the eye could see.

questions.stem: What stretched into the distance?
What did the farmer say about the winters?
What are the summer days like?

exercises.title: U4 听力·对话 Asking the Way in the City
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Daiyu: Excuse me, how far is the old town from here?
Local: It's about two kilometres south of the station, close to the water.
Daiyu: Can we walk there, or should we take a bus?
Local: You can easily walk. Just head south along this street.
Daiyu: Is there anything worth seeing on the way?
Local: Yes, there are lovely shops and an old market on your left.
Daiyu: Thank you so much. You've been very kind.
Local: No trouble at all. Enjoy the rest of your trip!
exercises.translation_cn: 戴玉问老城离这里多远;当地人说在车站以南约两公里、靠近水边;问能否步行;当地人说很容易,沿这条街向南走即可;路上左边有可爱的商店和一个老市场;戴玉道谢,当地人祝她旅途愉快。

questions.stem: Where is the old town?
options: Far to the north of the city.
About two kilometres south of the station.

questions.stem: How can Daiyu get to the old town?
Which way should she go?
What is worth seeing on the way?
options: Lovely shops and an old market.

questions.stem: How does the local person respond to Daiyu's thanks?
options: He says it was no trouble and wishes her a good trip.
He says he is too busy.

exercises.title: U4 听力·短文 A Tip for the Long Journey
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Here is a simple tip for anyone taking a long rail journey.
Do not spend the whole time staring at your phone.
Look out of the window and watch the land change around you.
Talk to the people sitting near you and learn about their home.
A slow journey enjoyed mile by mile becomes a memory for life.
exercises.translation_cn: 给坐长途火车的人一个简单贴士:别一路盯着手机;望向窗外,看身边大地的变化;和邻座的人聊天,了解他们的家乡;一段慢慢享受、一英里一英里走过的旅程,会成为一生的记忆。

questions.stem: Who is this tip for?
options: Anyone taking a long rail journey.

questions.stem: What does the speaker say you should not do?
options: Spend the whole time staring at your phone.

questions.stem: What should you watch through the window?
Why should you talk to people near you?
What does a slow journey become?
options: A reason to fly next time.
